r6_intermittent_test.note: Historical: it did not recur during the V4.2-R7 real pilot, the V4.2-R7.1 correction round, the V4.2-R8 round, or the V4.2 final closure regression runs, and was recorded then as non-reproducible. Later evidence supersedes that label: docs/V5/PRE_V5_1_RERUN_INTERMITTENCY_INVESTIGATION_RESULT.md identified the cause (transient Windows PermissionError on os.replace in atomic_write_text when rewriting a file inside a reused --output directory) and applied a bounded retry (_replace_with_retry in legacy_documenter/utils/atomic_write.py). Direct test coverage of that retry was added in V5.2 R4.2 (tests/test_v5_2_r4_2_pre_closure_corrections.py). Any recurrence of the symptom must still be treated as an investigation trigger.
